capabilities: record audio and system sound directly in the vault
transcribe recordings via cloud or local speech services
polish transcripts into notes with generated titles and extracted todos
manage recordings in an audio queue with retry and recovery
extras: Freemium: recording, notes, and transcription of recordings under 5 minutes are free; longer transcription, live transcription, dictation, speaker recognition, and Todo collection require a license code obtained via Xiaohongshu. The plugin is closed-source. The agent-facing CLI is marked as a test feature with changeable parameters.
problem: Obsidian's audio recorder only embeds recordings; turning spoken content from meetings or lectures into searchable, organized text notes requires external tools and manual work.

relations.evidence: Windows 桌面端可以一键安装 FunASR 转写程序并自动准备运行环境
需要本机装好 yt-dlp（ffmpeg 可选），插件只检测和调用
把录音写进 Daily Notes、Periodic Notes、Journals 等工具已经建好的当天日记

requires.name: transcription or LLM provider API key (e.g. SiliconFlow)
license code for locked features (long transcription, live transcription, dictation, speaker recognition)
yt-dlp for Bilibili audio import; FunASR for local transcription

summary: Voice recording plugin that records audio in the vault, transcribes it via cloud or local speech services, and polishes transcripts into structured Markdown notes.
